questions: Have you had these eye movements since birth or early childhood?
When you look straight ahead at a fixed target, are the eyes still moving?
When the eyes move, do they move in opposite directions to each other (one up while the other goes down)?
Do you feel that you or the room is spinning (vertigo)?
Do you have any hearing loss, ringing in the ears, or a feeling of pressure in the ear?
Have you had any weakness, numbness, or difficulty with balance or coordination?
Do you take any medications regularly (prescription or recreational)?
Have you ever been diagnosed with multiple sclerosis, a stroke, or a brain tumor?
